name: Raven Redfang
title: the bandit queen of the Redfangs
trope: The wild bandit rival who turns ally
temper: Loud, wild, greedy, fearless; loyal once she owes you
lore: She leads the Redfang crew out of the Crimson Woods and taxes every pretty traveller. Her coin belt jingles, so you hear her coming if she wants you to.
want: to owe nobody and be owed by everybody.
cost: she keeps a tally on her friends and pays every debt back twice as loud.
secret: She bites every coin to test it. Every new crush gets the same test.

body.build: Wild hair, loud voice, a coin belt that jingles

look: Wild long red hair, gold fox eyes, berry lipstick, black leather crop corset, crimson tattered cape, gold coin belt, twin daggers.

lines.meet: Toll road, sweetheart. Pay up in gold or kisses.
lines.flirty: Ooh, you're shiny. I'm gonna steal you.
lines.soft: ...You saved me. Ugh. Fine, I'm yours now.

barks: Jingle, jingle. That is your purse leaving.
